text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Whoa! It looked angry before, but now it's on another level!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわわ、
なんだかすごく怒ってらっしゃいます？
一段と迫力が……！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
It might be annoyed because we beat down so many
of its brethren.
We better take extra care here, just in case.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして、
さんざん仲間を痛めつけたから怒ってるのかしら？
これは気を抜けない戦いになりそうだわ……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
Let's finish it off and cook it up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
　
頑張って倒して、
おいしくいただいちゃいましょう！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Why does it always come down to food?!
